text: Stablecoin settlement is fast. Reconciliation is manual. Invoice Rail makes Arc payments finance-ready.
Wallet transfers show an address and amount, but not which invoice they settle—especially when amounts repeat or another wallet pays.
A merchant creates a USDC or EURC invoice, stores it in a team workspace, and shares a short payment link. Invoice Rail never receives private keys.
The payer signs one Arc Memo transaction. The invoice ID and exact transfer calldata are bound to the token transfer atomically.
A separate worker verifies the Memo contract, token, recipient, amount, transaction hash, and log index before marking the invoice paid.
This live test payment succeeded on Arc. ArcScan reported confirmation within point five one seconds.
Invoice Rail is live on Arc: non-custodial invoicing with exact onchain reconciliation.
